about: Exact sizes for SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-MTL-SHA2-128 with Verisign MTL v1.3.1 (commit 7cef019). Sizes are deterministic for a given algorithm and library version; `make verify` checks them in the pinned image. Condensed maxima equal the bound in draft-harvey-cfrg-mtl-mode-09 section 12; the plain signature size is the SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s parameter set in FIPS 205.
